subject: Short 15-min sync to review your usage spike and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@veloxai.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 13:41:00 -0700
Subject: Short 15-min sync to review your usage spike and next steps

Hi Alex —

Congrats on the recent activity — our system flagged a steady uptick from your account and you crossed the 75k tokens/day threshold this morning. Wanted to offer a quick 15-minute walk-through to make sure Redwood is configured for your workload and to highlight a couple of quick optimizations (batching, KV caching hints, and a lightweight quantization path) that typically reduce per-token cost without changing outputs.

Would any of these 15-minute slots work for you next week? All times PT:
- Thu Mar 23 — 10:00–10:15 PT
- Thu Mar 23 — 14:00–14:15 PT
- Fri Mar 24 — 11:00–11:15 PT

If you want a deeper technical dive we can extend to 30 minutes and bring an SE. If you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda attached.

Calendar link (pick a time): https://cal.redwood.com/ben/slots/veloxai
Attachment: MVP-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf, 1 page)

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Sales Development Representative, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

P.S. If you prefer someone from your team looped in, feel free to CC them on a reply.
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@veloxai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@veloxai.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Short 15-min sync to review your usage spike and next steps

Thanks, Ben — appreciate the heads up. 14:00 PT on Thu Mar 23 works for us (that’s 17:00 ET for our team). Can you please include a solutions engineer? We want to cover autoscaling behavior for short bursts and whether quantized variants change output fidelity for our summarization jobs.

Samir (cc’d) will join from our side. Also, our team is on ET — please send times converted to ET in the invite if possible.

Alex Kim
Head of Platform, VeloxAI
alex.kim@veloxai.com | (646) 555-8899

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Samir in.

Confirming: Thu Mar 23, 14:00–14:15 PT / 17:00–17:15 ET. I’ve created a calendar invite and attached a one-page agenda so we can stay tight on time. Marissa (cc’d) is our SE and will cover autoscaling and the quantization tradeoffs; Jordan (cc’d) will attend to flag any follow-up procurement/next-step items if that’s helpful.

Calendar invite: https://cal.redwood.com/invite?eid=veloxai-abc123
Attachment: MVP-demo-agenda.pdf

Quick ask for the SE — if possible, can you drop a short sample request (curl or a small JSON payload) or a representative concurrency pattern ahead of the call? If anything changes on timing I’ll update the invite. Looking forward to it.

Best,

Hi Alex — I’ll be on the call and happy to go over autoscale behavior and the quantized path. To make the 15 minutes useful, could you drop a single representative request or a 30–60 second screencap of a sample run in this folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/veloxai-sample-data ? That will let me prepare one or two specific tuning suggestions.

I’ve also attached a short SE checklist (SE-checklist.md) with the items I usually look for before a quick session. No need to overdo it — a curl example or a small JSON is perfect.

See you Thursday.

—Marissa
